anna (docs): Noticed an inconsistency in the /summarize API reference. The example curl shows the server returning a `request-id` header but our OpenAPI and SDKs use `x-request-id`. Found in PR comment: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3789

vishal (eng-api): Good catch. Runtime sets `request-id` for backwards compat, but our canonical header is `X-Request-Id` (kebab/capitalization differs across examples). We should standardize on `X-Request-Id` in docs and mention the runtime will preserve either header name in responses. Also note the header is returned only when tracing is enabled.

mel (sdk): Our clients normalize response headers to `x-request-id` in lower-case for convenience. Docs should show how to read it in JS/py: `resp.headers.get('x-request-id')` for fetch/fetch-like, and `resp.headers['x-request-id']` in requests. I'll add a short snippet we can link to.

taylor (docs-review): One more: the example response body in the docs shows `summary_text` but runtime returns `summary` (we recently changed field names in the response schema). Need to update example JSON and OpenAPI example to `summary`. Also add a migration note for integrators.

anna (docs): I'll open a PR to update the curl, python, and node snippets, canonicalize the header to `X-Request-Id`, and fix the response field to `summary`. Will add a small callout: "Note: runtime returns X-Request-Id when tracing is enabled; clients may observe `request-id` for older integrations."

mel (sdk): I'll prepare SDK docs update and a tiny helper `getRequestId(resp)` in the JS client that reads both header forms. Will link once ready.

vishal (eng-api): Also add a line in the OpenAPI note: server may include header only on success responses (2xx). For error responses we include `x-error-id`. Keep those examples separate.

ci-bot: docs-ci: running linter... (1 warning: code fence language missing in a snippet)

taylor (docs-review): Please ensure code fences have language and canonical Authorization header casing in curl examples (`Authorization`).

anna (docs): Pushed PR with updates, added migration blurb and fixed code fence languages. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3789

ci-bot: docs-ci: build passed. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-3789--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/summarize#response

anna (docs): Merging after CI green. Will follow up to add SDK helper link when Mel's PR is ready. Thanks all :sparkles:
